LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoActiveMap: There is no active colony map to arm.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoFreeColonists: There are no free colonists to arm.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoWeaponResearched: No weapon can be made yet: no weapon crafting is researched. Research a weapon, or place a crafting spot to make a simple one.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoWeaponBench: No weapon can be made: no workbench or crafting spot capable of building a weapon exists on any of your colony maps. A simple crafting spot is enough.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_Intro: One press: hand out weapons and gear by skill, queue the ammo, and offer to craft any weapons you don't own.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_AdHocTip: Every colonist gets the weapon that suits them - no roles involved.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_RolesTip: Review/build Roles first (step 1 opens in Role Mode), then assign colonists by Role exclusively (step 3 assigns "Roles only", same checkbox Equip Colonists already has).
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_PickModeHeader: Pick a mode preset, then fine-tune any step with its checkbox:
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DescDeleteAmmoManaged: deletes ammo bills this mod queued
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DescDeleteWeaponBillsManag: deletes weapon bills this mod queued
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DescNothing: Nothing existing is unassigned, changed, or deleted.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DescAmmoCreate: Creates ammo bills for what's missing.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DescAmmoNone: Does not create any ammo bills.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ResetPawnsTip: Unassign every colonist's loadout before the run, so 'fill gaps' naturally re-plans the whole colony.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteAmmoNone: Existing ammo bills are kept - nothing is deleted here. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteAmmoManaged: Deletes only ammo bills this mod's wizard queued. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteAmmoAll: Deletes every ammo bill, including the ones you placed yourself. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteAmmoTip: None: leave ammo bills alone. Managed: delete only bills this mod's own tooling created, so a bill you set up by hand yourself survives. All: delete every ammo bill for a recognized type regardless of who queued it (the original, blunt behavior).
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteWeaponBillsManaged: Deletes only weapon bills this mod's wizard queued. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteWeaponBillsAll: Deletes every weapon crafting bill, including the ones you placed yourself. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteWeaponBillsTip: None: leave weapon bills alone. Managed: delete only bills this mod's own tooling created (production queue, not the Loadout template), so a bill you set up by hand yourself survives. All: delete every weapon bill for a recognized weapon regardless of who queued it (the original, blunt behavior).
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteWeaponLoadoutsAll: Deletes the weapon loadouts you built by hand in CE's own loadout editor. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteWeaponLoadoutsTip: Only loadouts you built yourself in CE's native loadout editor. The hidden per-weapon templates this mod creates are never touched here - the run recreates them for every weapon it hands out anyway. Roles and Equipment Packs have their own steps.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteEquipmentPacksManage: Deletes only Equipment Packs THIS mod's wizard generated. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteEquipmentPacksAll: Deletes every Equipment Pack, including hand-built ones. No undo. ({0})
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_DeleteEquipmentPacksTip: None: leave Equipment Packs alone. Managed: delete only packs the Auto-generate wizard produced, so one you built by hand in the Ingredients tab survives. All: delete every Equipment Pack regardless of who made it (the original, blunt behavior). Hand-built loadouts are never touched here.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_AmmoBillsOff: No ammo bills are created or deleted.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_AmmoBillsOn: Creates ammo bills for what's missing.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_AmmoBillsTip: Untick to leave your ammo bills completely alone. Ticked: tops up bills for colonists this run ISN'T touching (already assigned before you clicked Arm my Colony). Nothing is ever deleted here - obsolete bills are offered for removal in the Supply popup, with a checkbox each. Colonists THIS run assigns get their own ammo bills later, from that same popup - so on a brand-new colony's very first run, this step has nothing to do yet.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_GoTip: Runs the steps exactly as ticked in the table above. The mode radios are only presets for the checkboxes.\n\nCurrent setup: {0}
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoteRolesLoseComposition: {0} role(s) kept their contents but lost the building blocks they were assembled from - those blocks were deleted. Colonists on those roles stay equipped; to re-tune a role, drag new parts onto it.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ContinueTipHasRoles: Continue to ammo bills and assignment. Colonists will be assigned by Role exclusively.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ContinueTipNoRoles: Continue to ammo bills and assignment. No roles exist yet - build at least one above, or nobody will be assigned.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_NoBillFor: No workbench currently has a bill for {0}.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_AbortedNote: Run aborted, the changes below were applied before it stopped.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportResetTip: The reset switches ran first (assignments, bills, loadouts) so the rebuild matches the current requirements exactly.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportPacksGeneratedTip: Starter pack palette created or refreshed in step 0 - see the Equipment Packs tab.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportAmmoBillsCreatedTipS: Demand-scaled to what colonists are assigned; itemised under Production queued below.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportAmmoBillsCreatedTipN: Nothing was missing - every needed ammo already had a bill.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportAssignmentsTip: Who received which loadout. Click a row to jump to that colonist on the map.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_JumpTip: Click to jump to {0} on the map.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportPawnsLeftUnassigned: {0} colonist(s) left without a loadout - see the Assign step for the reason.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportProductionTip: Weapons and ammunition this run put on your workbenches. "Bills" jumps to the workbench that carries the bill.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportNoneBlockedProd: - {0} item(s) needed, but nothing could be queued (no bench or recipe) -
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_RoundsQueuedTip: {0} rounds queued - demand-scaled to the assigned loadouts.
LanguageData.CER_ArmColony_ReportTotalMaterialsTip: Everything the queued production will consume, summed over all bills. Red = not enough in storage right now (full need/have list in the strip's tooltip).
